notes.title: Ascent: Rivals Version 0.8
notes.content:
Updates


Full UI/Menu Rework
New Item Economy

3 item tiers
New ‘Augment’ item type that apply buffs to equipped parts and weapons
50 new ship parts, weapons, and augments

Ship

Improved motion dynamics (less snappy over hills/ridges, less flipping, better strafing)
Closer camera perspective for better sense of speed
Engines now have 1-5 “stages” to allow different rates of acceleration at different speeds
Improved VFX for low health

Character Animations (Piloting, Combat, Taunts)
Combat

Hit detection improvements
Unique models for each weapon
Weapons now use energy from battery or pressurized air power from PRS
Piloting input is preserved when switching to combat, but slowly returns to idle state

Added matchmaking window


Quality of Life Changes


“STALLED” indicator when engines are killed
Added new hit indicator on HUD to tell what enemy part you damaged
Edit custom game settings after lobby creation
Parts are categorized into “Speed,” “Agility,” and “Combat” tabs
Improved overall game performance


Balance Changes


Quick transition time between combat/piloting
Races are now 4 heats
AR¢ is also passively rewarded at start of heats
Obelisk award AR¢
Tier now indicates strength instead of weight class, allowing lights to compete with heavies late game
Batteries are intrinsic to engine and no longer distinct part
Parts perform better at their respective weight classes

notes.title: Version 0.7
notes.content:
Updates

Various bugfixes
Stability and scalability improvements
Dynamic, independent ship part motion!
New medal/medal augment badges!
Added Gauntlets, our automatic tournament management system!
[NEW] Warp Drive
Aiming improvements


Fixed issue where aiming diagonally on gamepads was slower than cardinal directions
Aim-assist better accounts for projectile sizes for target confirmation



Quality of Life Changes

Added visual tick mark and audio queue as players place 1st–4th
5s countdown to ascension phase
Added total pit cost to reserve UI
More clear indication while watching an instant replay
Added ability for session leader to restart matches
Camera changes based off of stabilizer lift


Balance Changes

DMR fire rate decreased .25 → .27
DMR accuracy increased for both hip-fire and aim down sights
Light Engine top speed increased 22500 → 24000
Medium Warp Drive damage at max boost decreased 30 → 25

Revamped tutorial
 Scrimmage Mode (vs bots)
 "Try in Simulator" option in hangar + on-the-fly loadout modification in the simulator (tab/select)
 Totally new checkpoint/progress system now supporting branching paths
 Overwarping now brings your health to 1% and "fails" your warp
 Dynamic force field walls with shootable switches (Sandstorm only, currently)
 Ramming through players and killing them no longer halts your momentum
 Weapon recoil

notes.title: Major Update 0.6.0
notes.content: Quality of Life                    Performance optimizations on both client and server side.            Display loadout of spectated player when spectating.            Display loadout in pause screen.            Objective markers for obelisks during ascension phase.            Added ability to remap some controls from options menu.            Improved turning by staggered warp charging.            Renamed “APS” part to “Stabilizer(s).”            Improved PvP collisions.            Auto-benchmark machines on first run to set reasonable graphics settings.            Medals now show up in match replays.            Momentum and input is preserved when entering combat.            Added option to attempt reconnecting in “disconnected from game server” modal dialog.            Balanced part weight distribution and feel.                New Features                    Gameplay/controls tutorial.            Weight limit option for custom games.            Added end-of-match breakdown flow.            Display collected medals on pilot profile screen.            Bots will now engage in combat and have variable aggression.            Revamped HUD.            PRS part now uses a separate air tank resource, allowing more part variance.            New mouse control mechanism to control stabilizers, allowing lift control on mouse/keyboard input mode.            Inbox System.            Replay kills in the activity feed when spectating.            Stat breakdown per-course.            Players can now manually correct their ship’s roll angle via stabilizer/lift inputs.            Revamped spectator view.            WarpDrives now support new tunings per part.                Weapons                    New DMR.                Bug Fixes                    Fixed an issue causing ships to sometimes pitch downwards off of jumps.            Fixed laser showing when spectating someone aiming-down-sight.            Fixed reticle not turning red when spectating someone aiming at an enemy.            Fixed an issue causing ship to tunnel through certain types of geometry.            Fixed issue where you sometimes would not ascend when in an ascension zone.            Fixed an issue with battery capacity not updating after changing battery part.            Improved Match Connection Stability.            Improved support for Tethered connections.            Fix for Water Disappearing on Neulo when you are shot at.                Effects                    New Damage Effects on Cockpits and Engines.            New Effects for Passive Strafing.            Major Optimizations to general effects rendering.            Optimized Scene Rendering (Shadows, Lighting etc).            Optimized Explosions, Fire, Thrusters.                Parts                    New Heavy Engine.            New Light Cockpit.            New Thruster Colors on all engines.            New Texture and Effects pipeline for all parts (improves quality, artistic control, and iteration time for new parts).                Maps                    Small improvements to Dunes, Neulo, Oria, and Sandstorm.            Dynamic billboard system for major courses to enable sponsors and brands.            New beta map: Oria Transfer Station.            New beta map: Neulo Shores - Low Tide.            New alpha map: Illus Transit Corridor.            Handful of pre-alpha maps.

notes.title: Ascent: Rivals v0.3.4
notes.content:
User Interface:

- Revamped player HUD
- Added weight indicators to parts
- Added overall ship weight meter to stats view
- Added "starter" item indicators
- Added loadout view in pre-heat screen
- Updated race summary screen which now shows in between heats
- Added a dynamic news feed to the main menu screen

Gameplay:

- Ascent mode now behaves like it used to where you don't automatically ascend, you must survive
- Players can now ante-up in the pre-heat phase to put a bounty on their own heads and potentially double their winnings
- Fixed some issues around swapping parts in the pre-heat phase
- Crashed ship parts now can do chained explosions
- Added gameplay option to show or hide the mini-map
- Added gameplay option to display imperial or metric units

Spectating:

- Fixed issue with instant replays causing you to be stuck spectating someone in the past
- Free-camera and hiding HUD now function properly when spectating a match

General:

- Various bug fixes and stability improvements
- Added ability to view other players and their loadouts in the pre-heat phase
- Various map improvements
- Fixed issue where bots that were killed by a player had the incorrect respawn delay
- Improved dust particles so they now spawn along the ground
- Added unique names for bots
